label: CCPA § 1798.135 — Opt-out methods
body: (a) A business that sells or shares … shall, in a form that is reasonably accessible to consumers:
(1) Provide a clear and conspicuous link on the business' internet homepages, titled "Do Not Sell or Share My Personal Information," to an internet web page that enables a consumer to opt out;
(2) Provide a clear and conspicuous link … titled "Limit the Use of My Sensitive Personal Information" …;
(3) At the business' discretion, utilize a single, clearly labeled link in lieu of (1) and (2) if it easily allows both.
(b)(1) A business shall not be required to comply with subdivision (a) if it allows opt-out via an opt-out preference signal sent with the consumer's consent by a platform, technology, or mechanism …

(c)(1) A business shall not require a consumer to create an account or provide additional information beyond what is necessary in order to direct the business not to sell or share the consumer's personal information …
(c)(4) Wait at least 12 months before requesting that the consumer reauthorize sale or sharing of personal information or use of sensitive personal information for additional purposes.
